newsitem.title: USA: Interstate Hotels to buy two hotels.
newsitem.headline: Interstate Hotels to buy two hotels.

text.p: Interstate Hotels Co said on Tuesday it had entered into agreements to purchase two hotels for about $30.8 million.
One is the Radisson Plaza Hotel-San Jose Airport in San Jose, Calif., and the other is the Radisson Hotel in Englewood, N.J., the company said.

The total investment of $30.8 million for both hotels, including capital expenditures and estimated closing costs, will be financed by a combination of internally generated funds and the company's existing acquisition facility, Interstate said.
The acquisitions should close later this month, it said.
